code:
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

# Consolidated evidence table from the three HMM-defined family resources (UniProtKB membership)
data = {
 "Resource": ["PANTHER PTHR31525","InterPro IPR026218","Pfam PF16954"],
 "Total members": [1314, 1337, 1211],
 "Metazoa": [1311, 1333, 1208],
 "Choanoflagellata": [2, 2, 2],
 "Amoebozoa": [1, 1, 0],
 "Other eukaryotes": [0,0,0],
}
df=pd.DataFrame(data)
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print()
print("Non-metazoan members (all resources):")
print("  Monosiga brevicollis  (A9V514) - Choanoflagellata (Opisthokonta)")
print("  Salpingoeca rosetta   (F2UHH4) - Choanoflagellata (Opisthokonta)")
print("  Acanthamoeba castellanii (L8GV39) - Amoebozoa  [56.5% id to human HRG1]")
print()
print("Dictyostelium discoideum (UP000002195, 12726 proteins): 0 HRG members (PF16954=0, IPR026218=0)")

# Plot: lineage distribution (log scale) for PANTHER PTHR31525
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7,4))
lab=["Metazoa","Choanoflagellata\n(Opisthokonta)","Amoebozoa\n(Acanthamoeba)","Fungi / Plants /\nSAR / Discoba / etc."]
val=[1311,2,1,0]
colors=["#4C72B0","#55A868","#C44E52","#cccccc"]
bars=ax.bar(lab,[max(v,0.3) for v in val],color=colors)
ax.set_yscale("log")
ax.set_ylabel("UniProtKB proteins in PTHR31525 (log)")
ax.set_title("Phylogenetic distribution of HRG1/SLC48A1 family (PANTHER PTHR31525)")
for b,v in zip(bars,val):
    ax.text(b.get_x()+b.get_width()/2, b.get_height()*1.1, str(v), ha="center",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("hrg1_distribution.png",dpi=130)
print("\nSaved figure hrg1_distribution.png")
